own_solution.law: Static equilibrium: the ground normal force is N=(12+70)g=803.6 N. Taking moments about the foot gives the wall reaction H L sin(theta)=gL(12/2+70*0.6)cos(theta), hence H=470.4 cot(theta). Horizontal equilibrium makes the ground friction equal H. The total ground force is sqrt(N^2+H^2). At theta=62 degrees, H=250.116 N.
